steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('main')].find(e=>/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(e).overflowY)&&e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+4);return m||document.scrollingElement};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('main *')].find(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim()==="Nome da Empresa"&&e.offsetParent);if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-330);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=c.scrollTop,t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/700),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTo({top:y0+dy*e,behavior:'instant'});p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
